Compiles and runs correctly, with "Calling greet" printed before each of the two `greet()` calls.

**Summary:**
- `ast-tool find --text greet src/greeter.h` located the declaration at line 4.
- `ast-tool references greet src/` failed with an ambiguity error (header declaration and `.cpp` definition both resolve to unqualified name `greet`, and there's no namespace to fully-qualify), and no line/position-based disambiguation flag exists on this build — so I fell back to reading `src/main.cpp` directly, which showed calls at lines 4 and 5.
- Added `#include <iostream>` and a `std::cout << "Calling greet" << std::endl;` line immediately before each of the two `greet()` calls in `src/main.cpp`.
- Verified the build compiles (via clang++, since no CMakeLists.txt exists in this small repo) and runs, printing the logging line before each greeting as expected.
